snippet.title: Mario's Picross Deluxe - Pre-Alpha Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
PLEASE NOTE THIS IS A (really) EARLY ALPHA BUILD OF THE GAME !

Mario's Picross Deluxe is a remake of the game boy classic, entirely made from scratch in Unity and featuring modern controls and QoL improvements.
This demo contains 64 puzzles to complete.

Download here : 
Itch : https://neotail.itch.io/marios-picross-deluxe
SAGE : https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/marios-picross-deluxe-sage-2025-alpha-demo.2531/
